question: What is Vesharo and what services do you provide?
answer: Vesharo is a specialized IT services and AI automation engineering firm based in Ahmedabad, India. We engineer custom web and mobile applications, deterministic AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software for growing businesses and tech startups.

question: How do we get started on a project with Vesharo?
answer: You can schedule a free 15-minute call or email vesharo.ai@gmail.com. Our engineering leads will review your technical requirements, assess feasibility, and provide an initial architectural proposal and milestone plan within 48 hours.

question: What timezones does your engineering team support?
answer: Our engineering headquarters operates on Indian Standard Time (IST), but we maintain daily working overlap with client timezones across North America (EST/PST), the United Kingdom (GMT), and Europe (CET) for synchronous collaboration and daily standups.

question: Do your web applications comply with accessibility standards?
answer: Yes. Every web application we engineer targets WCAG 2.2 AA compliance by default. We build with semantic HTML5, full keyboard navigability, contrast-tested design tokens, and ARIA attributes for screen reader compatibility.

question: How do you ensure data security and confidentiality in AI systems?
answer: We enforce strict zero-data-retention agreements with LLM providers, isolate proprietary business data in private vector databases within your own cloud VPC, and apply deterministic verification guardrails before outputs reach production systems.

question: What business workflows can autonomous AI agents handle?
answer: Our AI agents automate structured multi-step workflows: support ticket triage, invoice extraction, CRM sync, internal knowledge retrieval (RAG), and data validation. We pair probabilistic LLMs with deterministic code tools to guarantee reliable execution.

question: How do you prevent hallucinations in customer-facing AI agents?
answer: We prevent hallucinations using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) strictly bounded to verified internal knowledge, schema-enforced JSON tool calls, fallback routing to human teams, and programmatic confidence score thresholds.

question: Which foundation AI models and tools do you build with?
answer: We select models based on latency and cost: Claude 3.5 Sonnet for complex coding and reasoning, GPT-4o for multimodal processing, and self-hosted open-source models (Llama 3, DeepSeek) on private GPUs when strict on-premise privacy is required.

question: What core technologies and frameworks does Vesharo use?
answer: We build with modern, battle-tested technologies: TypeScript, React, Astro, Next.js, Node.js, Go, Python (for AI orchestration), PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and AWS / Google Cloud infrastructure.

question: Do you develop native mobile apps or cross-platform solutions?
answer: We build primarily using React Native and Flutter, achieving 90%+ shared codebases with native 60 FPS performance, offline SQLite/WatermelonDB sync, biometric security, and native device hardware integrations on iOS and Android.

question: How do you ensure code quality and avoid regressions?
answer: Every project includes automated CI/CD pipelines executing TypeScript type-checks, ESLint rules, unit tests, and end-to-end integration tests. Pull requests require peer code review and passing test suites before merging.

question: Can you audit, refactor, or take over an existing codebase?
answer: Yes. We conduct thorough architecture and code quality audits for teams facing technical debt or performance bottlenecks. We identify security risks, establish automated tests, and refactor code iteratively without pausing active operations.

question: What cybersecurity practices do you implement in development?
answer: We follow OWASP Top 10 security standards, enforce automated vulnerability scanning in CI, manage encrypted secrets via vault/cloud managers, enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.3, and implement strict input validation and SQL parameterization.

question: What does a typical project timeline look like from kickoff to launch?
answer: Engagements start with a 1-week technical discovery sprint. Production MVPs typically launch in 4 to 8 weeks. Larger platforms follow 2-week agile delivery cycles with working, tested software demonstrated at each sprint boundary.

question: How quickly can Vesharo begin work after contract signing?
answer: Once the initial technical discovery or milestone statement of work is agreed upon, our engineering squad provisions environments and begins active sprint execution within 3 to 5 business days.

question: How do you handle daily communication and sprint updates?
answer: You collaborate directly with senior technical architects via Slack or Microsoft Teams. We conduct bi-weekly sprint demos, share asynchronous daily summaries, and maintain real-time task boards in ClickUp or GitHub Projects.

question: How do you modernize legacy software without business downtime?
answer: We utilize the Strangler Fig architectural pattern: identifying high-value modules in your legacy system, re-architecting them into modern microservices or decoupled interfaces, and progressively migrating traffic with zero downtime.

question: Will you configure automated CI/CD deployment pipelines for our systems?
answer: Yes. Every production project includes automated GitHub Actions or GitLab CI workflows that automate linting, test suites, container builds, and staging/production deployments to AWS, GCP, or Vercel.

question: What engagement models does Vesharo offer?
answer: We offer four clear models: (1) Fixed-Scope Milestone Projects for well-defined deliverables, (2) Dedicated Engineering Squads on monthly retainers, (3) Support & Maintenance Retainers for production SLAs, and (4) Free Technical Discovery Calls.

question: Do you charge fixed price or time and materials?
answer: We prefer fixed milestone pricing for well-scoped projects because it guarantees budget certainty. For fast-evolving products with dynamic roadmaps, our dedicated engineering squad operates on transparent monthly sprint retainers.

question: Are cloud hosting and third-party API costs included in your fees?
answer: No. Cloud hosting (AWS, GCP) and third-party APIs (OpenAI, Twilio, SendGrid) are billed directly to your corporate accounts. This guarantees full data ownership, billing transparency, and zero intermediary markup.

question: How are payment schedules and milestones structured?
answer: Fixed-scope projects are broken into milestone payments tied to verifiable deliverable completions: initial architectural kickoff, core feature demonstration, and final deployment handoff. Monthly squads are invoiced at sprint boundaries.

question: Who owns the code and intellectual property produced during the project?
answer: You own 100% of all intellectual property, source code, database architectures, and deployment configurations. Full rights and repository ownership are transferred to your organization upon milestone completion.

question: Will you sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before project discussions?
answer: Yes, absolutely. We routinely sign mutual NDAs before reviewing proprietary requirements, internal workflows, architectural diagrams, or confidential business data.

question: Do you provide post-launch support and warranty coverage?
answer: Every production release includes a complimentary 30-day bug-fix warranty. Afterwards, we offer monthly SLA retainers covering 24/7 uptime monitoring, security patches, framework upgrades, and feature iterations.

question: What is included in the project handover and knowledge transfer?
answer: We deliver comprehensive documentation: system architecture diagrams, API specs, deployment guides, recorded video walkthroughs, and conducted live training sessions with your internal engineering team.
